about: Byte caps on the tools/list result (compact JSON, as the stdio shim writes it) per schema profile, protocol version and role profile. Measured 2026-09-25 (WS-54); remember content made optional and the WS-19A lifecycle arguments added as Advanced 2026-09-26, and the WS-19B provenance and evidence-bound vote arguments the same day (full caps grew by exactly their cost each time). WS-18 (2026-09-28): the search description now names BM25 over bodies and lost 59 bytes, search's outputSchema gained omitted and next_cursor (58 bytes, 2025-06-18 only), and the Advanced cursor and path_glob arguments cost 198 bytes in the full profile; lean caps were lowered to the measured sizes. Lower a cap when the list shrinks; never raise one to fit an addition: advertise less (declare the argument Advanced, documented at xmustard://docs/tools) or trim a description. cmd/xmustard-api checks role_profiles against the route gates.
